1.0: I knew I was right about you. Now that you're a member of our little club, I'll give you a Silent Crusader Medal.\r\n#L0##bA Medal? What's this for?#l\n#k
1.1: This is a mark of service that all our agents have. We reward completed missions with Crusader Coins, which you can use to enhance your medal and display your prowess.\r\n#L0##bWait, you guys have coins, too?#l\n#k
1.2: Of course! Any decent secret society has their own currency. Why, we can't just use any old coins, because...\r\nAnyway, I'm sure everyone is looking forward to working with you.

yes.0: You got your medal, right? Display it proudly, except when you're in public. Secret society and all...
